title: WPMS/1873/2013 of Anuj Kashyap Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1873 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. A.K. Joshi, Addl. C.S.C. for the
respondents / State.
When petitioner was posted as Chowkidar
in Leesa Depot Sargakhet, residential
accommodation was allotted to the petitioner;
now petitioner is posted in Forest Division,
Nainital and is working in Nainital city; petitioner
has been asked to vacate residential
accommodation of Sargakhet earlier allotted to
the petitioner; feeling aggrieved, petitioner has
approached this Court.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, learned counsel for the
petitioner submits that Sargakhet is also within the
Forest Division, Nainital. His children are
studying and residing in the official
accommodation allotted to the petitioner at
Sargakhet. Further contends that petitioner has
not been allotted another accommodation as yet,
therefore, petitioner should be allowed to retain
residential accommodation at Sargakhet till 31st
March, 2016 keeping in mind school going
children of the petitioner.
In the peculiar facts and circumstances of
the case, I direct that petitioner shall not be
evicted from the residential accommodation of
Sargakhet till alternate accommodation is allotted
to the petitioner in Nainital Forest Division or till
31st March, 2016 whichever is earlier.
Writ petition stands disposed of
accordingly.
(Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 30.07.2015
